purpose: Teach: ハワイアン/ノーマル/ヤンキー/ハーモニー/ユニオン/ベール/ダイジェスト/レベルアップ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハワイアン音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really likes Hawaiian music, you know?
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Gentle observation delivered as if remembering something tender. Warm pace, slight pause before the name at the end—affectionate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ノーマルなブレンドコーヒーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer likes their coffee just regular blend, don't they.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment with understated warmth. Noticing the simple preference the way she notices everything. Steady tempo, slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、昔ヤンキーだったって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer used to be a delinquent—laughed about it, actually.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost amused. A small knowing smile underneath. Pace quickens slightly on the laugh, conspiratorial warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、合唱のハーモニーが上手だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's really good at choir harmonies.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Delivered like she's sharing something she noticed and likes about this person. Warm, unhurried, reverent almost.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨーロッパユニオン関連のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer works in something EU-related.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation but still tender. Not impressed, just—noticing and filing away. Conversational pace, almost offhand kindness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、結婚式のベールのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer talked about their wedding veil—told you the whole story.
lines.style: Soft recognition of intimacy. She's noting something was shared, trusted. Slower pace, respectful pause before the end, like holding something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外ドラマのダイジェスト版を見てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer watches the digest versions of foreign dramas.
lines.style: Quiet observation about a small habit. No judgment, just—noticing. Steady, almost meditative delivery. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲームのレベルアップを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told you about leveling up in some game.
lines.style: Final observation, delivered with the same attentive warmth as the others. Tempo slows just slightly at the close, like coming to rest. Still present, still noticing.
